starting_history.fas_historical_record: FAS-00 -> S01 accessibility -> S05 representation/readout match -> S11 fresh-world transport
starting_history.engineering_question: Can one pinned frozen representation cache support five independent narrow observers with useful task performance and lower repeated extraction/storage cost?

task_endpoints.context_identity: closed-set context_term_id classification over all 32 fitted classes
task_endpoints.entity_identity: closed-set entity_term_id classification over all 32 fitted classes
task_endpoints.relation: 2-way relation_id classification; fit and score only both terms in train-side ID ranges
task_endpoints.observed_state: 3-way state_id classification; fit and score only both terms in train-side ID ranges
task_endpoints.exact_target: 3-way exact_target prediction; fit only both terms in train-side ID ranges; score in-domain and the three frozen novel-term slices

performance_gates.gate: one-sided 95 percent whole-quartet-bootstrap lower bound >= 0.90 for each endpoint
performance_gates.multiplicity_statement: These are eight individual engineering gates. They do not provide a simultaneous 95 percent guarantee over the bundle; no familywise or multiplicity-adjusted claim is made.

bootstrap.resampling_unit: whole quartet; all four rows are sampled together
bootstrap.identity_strata: quartet baseline A-variant context_term_id for context identity; baseline A-variant entity_term_id for entity identity
bootstrap.target_strata: exact_target within each predeclared evaluation endpoint
bootstrap.sampling: within each task-specific class stratum, sample the original number of eligible test quartets with replacement

observer_fit.scaler: train-only float64 chunked Welford population mean/scale, chunk_rows=2048; zero scales become 1; persist mean and scale as little-endian float32
observer_fit.linear_model: multinomial linear readout; zero-initialized float32 weights and bias; mean cross-entropy plus 0.5 * 1e-4 * sum(weights squared); no bias regularization

serving_workloads.declared_bundle_serving_workload: one raw input -> one backbone extraction -> all five requested heads
serving_workloads.single_head_workload: one raw input -> one requested head
serving_workloads.single_head_claim: B1 and B2 each require one backbone extraction for a single-head request; no shared-compute advantage is claimed for this workload.
serving_workloads.five_output_fanout_claim: B1 performs one extraction plus five readouts; B2 performs five separate pipeline extractions plus five readouts. Label B2 fanout costs as receipt-derived counterfactual arithmetic unless executed.

economics.B1_SHARED: one measured full-panel extraction, one feature cache and row manifest, five independent heads
economics.B2_FIVE_PIPELINES: five pipeline extractions over the same rows, five identical task caches and manifests, one input corpus shared read-only; primary offline counterfactual
economics.B3_FIVE_DEPLOYED_BACKBONES: five separately stored/loaded backbone copies; deployment-context arithmetic only

resource_limits.peak_gpu_memory_gate_metric: extractor-process PyTorch CUDA caching-allocator reserved peak; not total GPU memory used by E2

gpu_measurement_protocol.reset_timing: after CUDA device availability check and before tokenizer/model loading or model transfer
gpu_measurement_protocol.final_sampling: torch.cuda.synchronize(cuda:0) followed by current allocated, current reserved, peak allocated, and peak reserved after extraction and repeat gate
gpu_measurement_protocol.device_wide_diagnostic: nvidia-smi used/free memory sampled approximately every 10 seconds, plus before/after snapshots; reported separately and never attributed to the extractor PID
gpu_measurement_protocol.scope_limit: PyTorch caching-allocator metrics exclude CUDA context and any non-PyTorch driver allocations; the extractor uses PyTorch for model and tensor allocations
gpu_measurement_protocol.e2_v01_retroactive_reclassification: none; the preserved v01 GPU resource gate remains UNVERIFIED
gpu_measurement_protocol.scope_claim_exact: E2 GPU gate = extractor-process PyTorch CUDA caching-allocator reserved peak; not total GPU memory used by E2.
gpu_measurement_protocol.scope_definition: torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(cuda:0), sampled in the extractor process after resetting PyTorch CUDA peak statistics; process-local allocator-reserved peak only.
gpu_measurement_protocol.pre_reset_sample_timing: after CUDA initialization and device availability check, before any tokenizer load, model load, or model transfer
gpu_measurement_protocol.pre_reset_clean_baseline_gate: record current allocated, current reserved, peak allocated, and peak reserved; require all four counters exactly zero or preserve a stop receipt and stop before model/tokenizer loading
gpu_measurement_protocol.post_reset_sample_timing: immediately after torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(cuda:0) and before tokenizer load or model transfer
gpu_measurement_protocol.post_reset_clean_baseline_gate: record the same four counters and require all four exactly zero or preserve a stop receipt and stop before model/tokenizer loading

phases.E0: E0 v05 proposes a resource-measurement amendment only; it remains draft until explicitly frozen and sealed.
phases.E1: fresh panel, whole-quartet split, separate labels, support receipt, resource preflight, and seal
phases.E2: E2 v02 requires a new explicit model-contact authorization after E0 v05 is sealed and the E2 v02 wait receipt passes; records clean pre-reset and post-reset process allocator baselines, captures process-scoped PyTorch allocator peaks, requires exact cache SHA/length equality to the read-only E2 v01 comparator, and writes one V1_FINAL_POSITION cache only.
phases.E3: Fit and score remain separately unauthorized; E2 v02 success does not grant E3.

program_boundary.immediate_downstream_option: routing integration only after v01 closes and passes
deferred: universal capability cartography until v01 closes

amendment.reason: E2 v01 telemetry was device-wide while an independently identified FAS-S12 workload ran concurrently; process attribution and the 10 GiB per-process GPU gate therefore remain unverified.

concurrent_gpu_wait_gate.wait_before: runtime/model/tokenizer import or CUDA model contact in E2 v02
concurrent_gpu_wait_gate.also_wait_for: any process whose command line contains the exact canonical run_s12_v02.py script path, including relaunches under another PID
concurrent_gpu_wait_gate.success_condition: zero matching script processes on two consecutive Win32_Process snapshots at least 30 seconds apart
concurrent_gpu_wait_gate.pid_reuse: record exact PID reuse and continue matching by canonical script path
concurrent_gpu_wait_gate.operator_action: observe and wait; do not terminate, suspend, reprioritize, or otherwise alter the concurrent process
concurrent_gpu_wait_gate.receipt: status WAIT_COMPLETE_STABLE_ABSENCE, exact process identity observed, final matching process list empty, stable absence samples and interval recorded, model_contact_performed_by_waiter=false

amendment_history.reason: The v03 validator read minimum_test_rows_per_class at the top level while the frozen panel contract nests it under support_gate. Both previous E1 attempts stopped before any panel rows were written.

representation_equivalence_gate.reference_role: read-only hash comparator only; not reused as v02 feature input and not eligible for fitting
representation_equivalence_gate.output_gate: exact SHA-256 equality and exact byte length equality
representation_equivalence_gate.mismatch_disposition: preserve v02 cache and failure receipt; stop; no tolerance comparison or in-place repair
